fixes.problem: Persona name labels at the bottom of each avatar card are drawn with solid, opaque colored pills (green, navy, brown, gray, olive) that are narrower than the card. The real labels are a full-width translucent white/gray strip across the card bottom with white text. The heatmap shows red on every label.
fixes.fix: Make each label a full-width strip (card width, ~24px tall, flush with the card bottom, rounded only at the bottom corners) with background rgba(255,255,255,0.3) or about #FFFFFF4D and white 15px medium text centered. Remove the per-persona colors. Keep the avatar art at its listed rect.

fixes.problem: The bottom row 'Try something else' first tile is drawn with a lighter, different purple bunny, and the tile background is wrong. The heatmap is red on it.
fixes.fix: Use a dark gray (#2A2A2A) tile at x16,y783,w121 with the bunny in muted lavender (#8A7FC0) at ~70px centered, matching the real screen. The plus tile at x145 stays #3A3A3A-ish with a white plus icon.

fixes.problem: Title 'Photoedit', 'By Luzia', the action pills (2K, 1.4K, Share) and 'Report app' text sit ~1px higher than the real screen and look bolder or wider. The heatmap shows red on the text.
fixes.fix: Shift the title, byline, pill labels and Report app text down 1px. Set the title to 22px weight 500-600 with a slightly narrower letter-spacing, so its right edge ends at x≈121. Use 14px medium for the pill labels. Make the bookmark icon orange (#E8905A) and the heart icon pink-red (#E8455F), smaller (~14px).

fixes.problem: The hero card's bottom edge and the 'Open app' pill are 1-2px higher than the real screen. The heatmap shows a red outline around the card and the button label.
fixes.fix: Move the 'Open app' pill down 1px, to y≈566, with the label baseline at y≈584. Keep the card border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.25), radius 24px, bottom at y≈617.

fixes.problem: The Trending tab row and category chips (Hot, New, Creative, Arcade, Tools) have icons and labels that are wider and drawn with a different font size. The heatmap shows red on the chips.
fixes.fix: Use 15px labels with 6px icon gaps. Position New at x≈83 with its icon, Creative at x≈157, Arcade at x≈255, Tools at x≈346. Icons should be thin outline, 18px, gray #B0B0B0.

fixes.problem: The 'Hot' game cards at the bottom (arcade game with red border pixel sprites, Chess 2000 ELO) are drawn in the wrong style and lack the dark game screenshot detail. The heatmap shows heavy red.
fixes.fix: Redraw the left card as a dark navy (#1B1F3A) grid with pixel-dot columns on the right side, a 'CHAOS 000000 ♥♥♥' header and a 'WANTED ☆☆☆☆☆' label. Draw the right card with a brown frame (#5A4A3A), the title 'Chess 2000 ELO' in serif on a tan header, and a checkerboard below. Card tops at y≈614.

fixes.problem: Header text 'My Apps' and 'Explore' and the featured card text (CREATIVE, Photoedit, Edit your images) are 1px off and wider or bolder than the real. The heatmap shows red on them.
fixes.fix: Set 'My Apps' to 22px, weight 500, gray #8A8A8A, letter-spacing 0. Shift the CREATIVE, Photoedit and Edit your images text down 1px. Make the Photoedit title 20px weight 600.

fixes.problem: The chat greeting paragraph is drawn 1-2px off vertically and has slightly different letter spacing and weight, so every line shows red on the heatmap. The small pill under 'Our new chat' also differs.
fixes.fix: Set the greeting to 17.5px, weight 400, line-height 20px, first baseline at y≈131, and left-aligned at x16. Reduce the letter-spacing slightly so the line 1 wrap ends at 'here to' at x≈390. Shift the footer disclaimer up 1px and use 11px so it spans x≈50-361.

fixes.problem: The Teacher header avatar is slightly different and its label 'Teacher' appears a bit bolder and lower. The small pill under the 'Our new chat' bar differs from the real screen (the real has a small darker pill with text).
fixes.fix: Use weight 500 at 20px for the Teacher title, baseline y≈35. Draw a small dark pill at x≈181-229, y≈88-102 with border 1px #333 and a faint text label.

summary: Layout is already very close, with all data-el elements placed within 4px and no failed taps, so the remaining gain is visual fidelity. The biggest visible differences are the s04 persona label strips (opaque colored pills instead of full-width translucent bars), the s14 game cards and chips, and small text weight and position offsets on s13 and s15. This round should fix the s04 labels first, then the s14 cards, then the text metrics.
